product: WRS Health Web EHR and Practice Management System
notes: The PDF provides ONLY file-level descriptions. No column names, data types, value sets, or field-level documentation exists for any of the CSV files. The C-CDA is referenced as standard USCDI v1 with no vendor-specific detail.

entities.description: Financial transactions with the provider. Includes patient information, transaction dates, charges, claims, and the description of transactions made with status.
entities.notes: No column names, types, or value sets documented. Only a prose description of general content.

entities.description: XML file export of a patient's clinical data. Complies with HL7 C-CDA and USCDI Version 1 requirements. Specifications obtainable from HL7 website.
entities.notes: Standard C-CDA per USCDI v1. No vendor-specific extensions or additional mappings documented. No profile detail beyond the reference to HL7 spec.

entities.description: Patient's key information, identification details, contact information, insurance information.
entities.notes: No column names, types, or value sets documented.

entities.description: Record of patient's encounters with specific information including appointment date, provider, location, appointment type, workflow, notes, and date on which notes are recorded.
entities.notes: No column names, types, or value sets documented. Mentions ~7 conceptual data points in prose.

entities.description: Mapping file listing patient documents/attachments contained in the Documents folder.
entities.notes: No column names or types documented.

entities.format: Various (PDF, DOCX, XLS, XML, HTML, DAT, JPG, GIF, PNG, etc.)
entities.description: Folder containing patient's supporting documents/attachments, lab results, and documents uploaded by the practice. Filename convention references patient name and patient ID.
entities.notes: Raw file attachments. No structured data dictionary.

entities.description: Encounter notes from patient visits. Each note is an HTML file with accompanying CSS, images, and JavaScript for readable formatting. Filename references patient name, ID, date, and note type.
entities.notes: Rendered HTML notes — narrative clinical content, not structured/computable data.

entities.description: Mapping file listing all patient notes generated during the export.
entities.notes: No column names or types documented.

entities.description: Log of successfully exported notes and any notes that encountered errors during export.
entities.notes: Export process log, not patient data.
